high_level_description: This image shows the exterior of a building at night, illuminated by artificial lighting. The building has a modern architectural design with a flat roof and rectangular windows. The upper part of the building features a sign that reads "Olive & Orchard Banquet Hall" in a stylized font, with the words "Banquet Hall" written below in smaller letters. The sign is lit up, making it stand out against the dark sky. Below the main sign, there is another section of the building with a red background. On this section, there is text in both English and what appears to be Tamil script.
